extractions.value: Patient had GlyR-ab mediated autoimmune encephalitis with prominent brainstem involvement but WITHOUT muscular rigidity, spasms, or startle (classic SPSD features explicitly absent). Cause of death was cardiac arrest secondary to aspiration with respiratory failure, leading to severe postanoxic encephalopathy.
extractions.quote: We report a patient with prominent brainstem involvement but without muscular rigidity or spasms. ... he never developed axial or limb rigidity, stiffness, muscle spasms, nor startle. ... He died a couple of days later, after the diagnosis of severe postanoxic encephalopathy.
